modelingNotes: Exact unsuffixed 8570/12-407, manufacturer article 150555: 16 A, 480-500 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 3P+PE, black, 7h. Installed hardware revision is unverified. The 20 A option and newer same-order/suffixed articles are not substituted. Terminal capability 500 V is the upper rating bound, not an authored supply voltage.

R. STAHL Plugue SolConeX 16 A Serie 8570/12, 227966/8570623300, 2017-02-08 BA00 III br 02, p.9 diagram 19041E00 identifies L1/L2/L3 and earth for 8570/12-4.. in a 6h front view; its table specifies 480-500 V, 50/60 Hz, black, 7h. https://r-stahl.com/fileadmin/tx_aimeos/Files/1_/02/0000000000000008570623300_001_02.pdf. No rotated 7h coordinates, rear view, numeric pin mapping or installed phase assignment is inferred.

C.L1/C.L2/C.L3/C.PE are cable-side functional pole endpoints and M.L1/M.L2/M.L3/M.PE are the corresponding mating contacts. L1/L2/L3 are manufacturer contact identities, C/M are authoring side aliases and PE is a textual alias for the earth symbol. Actual cable-clamp legends and individual screw positions are unverified. Verify physical terminal markings before use.

A plug has fixed contact conductors, not switched power poles. Author four explicit project jumpers C.L1-M.L1, C.L2-M.L2, C.L3-M.L3 and C.PE-M.PE to represent the hardware. The singleton bus functions and connector metadata never join nets themselves. These jumper objects represent factory continuity, not field-installed jumpers.

Connect cable-side PE: 2017 instructions p.10 require the protective conductor. The required C.PE presence check can pass on the internal PE jumper alone and does not establish an external protective-earth supply. Shared connection policy accommodates the internal representation plus an external lead, not multiple field conductors under a clamp.

Three power contacts and one PE contact are supported; no neutral, shield, signal, communication, auxiliary contact or additional bonding screw is verified for this exact base plug. A protective cap is a separate mechanical accessory and is outside this type.

The 2007 combined 8570/11,8570/12 manual, 8570618300 S-BA-8570/11/12-03-it-31/01/2007, pp.6-8 and 11-12 corroborates legacy 16 A four-pole construction, coding and plug termination. https://r-stahl.com/fileadmin/tx_aimeos/Files/1_/03/0000000000000008570618300_001_03/Manual_de_instrucciones_8570618300_001_03.pdf. Family illustrations do not establish the installed hardware revision.

The exact datasheet specifies one 1.5-4 mm2 finely stranded conductor per screw termination; no wire size is selected by this model. Temperature, sealing/ingress, Ex suitability, mating compatibility, conductor sizing and protection require the installed hardware and application review. Compiler validation is not an engineering approval.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four cable-side endpoints and four mating contacts are inventoried. L1/L2/L3/earth identities come from the four-contact manufacturer drawing; exact 7h physical orientation, actual cable-clamp markings and individual screw/bond positions remain unverified. C/M and textual PE are authoring aliases. All four fixed internal conductors require explicit project jumpers. No accessories are fitted.
